method: tc/netem RTT sweep; least-squares slope of wall time vs RTT per schedule; r_h = (R_eff(s) - R_eff(00)) / K_h
rtt_convention: configured delay = added RTT; on loopback the bidirectional netem factor is divided out (delay_mult)
r_h_basis: 1 (①/② exchange) + SCI rounds from client mpc_s vs RTT; wall-time slope kept as cross-check (it also counts TCP slow-start RTTs of the ciphertext transfers)
note: R_eff(00) should be ~2 (M1 up, M3 down) plus the session handshake when the context is not reused; the difference cancels the handshake.
